title: dev/land.py bounds a hung suite by wall time only, never by a CPU ceiling
done_when: dev/land.py suite() refuses a suite that fails or hangs past repo.json suite_seconds wall seconds (1200, the bound HANG * 120 gave), and no longer refuses a passing suite for its CPU seconds.
